accepted.matchup: Hawaii Rainbow Warriors @ Northern Illinois Huskies
accepted.reason: Money moved to NIU after the snapshot: Pinnacle went from Hawaii -3.5 / NIU +151 to NIU +3 / +130, and US books are at +118 to +130. That puts NIU's fair win chance near 42.5% against the 40.8% needed at +145, and Hawaii plays a 9:30 a.m. body-clock kickoff on its first trip to DeKalb.

After the snapshot the market moved through the key number to BYU -7.5 at -109 to -115 (MGM -8). Pinnacle's -7 price implies about 55% to win excluding pushes, against 53.5% needed, and a 7-point win is a push.

LeBron James was downgraded to OUT on the 1pm ET NBA injury report, after the snapshot, and the Bucks have no injuries listed. They are now +410 to +465 across the market (about 17.5-18% fair), so +490 is roughly 2-6% positive expected value.
